lessons: Implement's diff was sound: the Verification suite passed (259 tests), and the full suite, lint and format passed. The head regression printed pass. Only the base run of the bug_evidence check failed. A rerun of the same ticket fails the same way.

Root cause: the base regression run raised `[Errno 2] No such file or directory: '.venv/bin/python'`, so it exited with no code. The ticket's own reproducer never ran on base, so this proves nothing about the defect.

Engine defect, outside the fence: clutch/stages.py `_base_worktree` creates a fresh detached worktree with no .venv. `execute()` then runs the relative argv `.venv/bin/python` with cwd=base_worktree. The head worktree only has a .venv because Implement ran uv there.

A human should fix the engine so the base run gets the same interpreter as head (e.g. resolve against the engine venv; stages.py:872 already derives engine_bin from sys.executable). Or a human changes this ticket's ## Regression command to a form that runs in a fresh worktree.

The same `.venv/bin/python tests/regress_*` form is in ~88 ticket.md files under tickets/. Check whether other bug tickets fail bug_evidence the same way, and add a lint or gate so a regression interpreter that is missing at base is caught before Check.
